label: No pure determination of an actual root REQUIRES_LACK_2 in it the lack of pure determinations
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every actual concrete root r at w, no pure determination t that r has requires, in r (REQUIRES_LACK_2), the lack of a set of pure determinations. It is the in-root counterpart of the purity of requirements (0c8631bd), restricted to actual roots, with the same rationale: requiring the lack of a positive actuality is a limitation of the requirer, here of the determination as realized in the root. It is restricted to roots because a pure determination realized in a finite bearer can require there the lack of a pure one (a finite knower's knowing excludes knowing everything at once). With the bridge from REQUIRES_LACK_2 to REQUIRES_LACK_1 at roots it follows from 0c8631bd (pureRequiresNoPureLackInOfAsSuch). A simple root that lacks noesis by a clause of its one nature, with its being as realized in it requiring that lack, denies it (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 3); the Plotinian line (the unity of the first excludes the duality of thought, and this is no limitation) denies it.
